title: A More Than 80% Chance of a Tesla and SpaceX Merger? It Could Be a Game Changer.
title_zh: 特斯拉和 SpaceX 合并的可能性超过 80%？它可能会改变游戏规则。
summary: The debate over a possible Tesla-SpaceX merger is getting harder to ignore.
summary_zh: 关于特斯拉与 SpaceX 可能合并的争论越来越难以忽视。

title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Expands Its Edge AI Computing Hardware Offerings
title_zh: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) 扩展其边缘人工智能计算硬件产品
summary: Super Micro Computer Inc. (NASDAQ:SMCI) is one of BlackRock’s 30 most important AI stocks right now. BlackRock is the largest institutional owner in the company, with 7.21% or 43.36 million outstanding shares, according to Yahoo Finance data.
summary_zh: Super Micro Computer Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：SMCI）是贝莱德目前最重要的 30 只人工智能股票之一。雅虎财经数据显示，贝莱德是该公司最大的机构所有者，拥有 7.21% 或 4336 万股流通股。

title: Jeff Bezos Held 60 Meetings To Secure Amazon Investors But 40 Declined His Offer Of $50K For 1% Ownership — Today, That Would Be Worth $25B
title_zh: 杰夫·贝佐斯举行了 60 次会议以确保亚马逊投资者的安全，但 40 人拒绝了他以 5 万美元换取 1% 所有权的报价 — 如今，这将价值 $25B
summary: A $50,000 check can buy plenty of things. In 1995, it could have bought a sliver of an online bookstore that many people did not yet understand because they were still asking one very fair question: What’s the internet? Amazon...
summary_zh: 一张5万美元的支票可以买很多东西。 1995年，它本可以收购一家网上书店的一小部分，但许多人还不了解，因为他们仍在问一个非常公平的问题：什么是互联网？亚马逊...

title: This AI Chip Stock Just Signed Massive Deals With 3 Hyperscalers, and It Still Looks Like a Great Buy Right Now (Hint: Not Nvidia or Intel)
title_zh: 这家 AI 芯片股刚刚与 3 家超大规模公司签署了大规模交易，目前看起来仍然值得买入（提示：不是 Nvidia 或英特尔）
summary: Data center chip sales could go from $0 to $15 billion in four years.
summary_zh: 四年内数据中心芯片销售额可能从 0 美元增至 150 亿美元。

title: Foes of PNM takeover applaud as regulators order $400 million stock deal undone
title_zh: 监管机构下令撤消 4 亿美元股票交易，PNM 收购的反对者欢呼雀跃
summary: New Mexico regulators voted Thursday to nullify a year-old purchase of stock in the state’s largest electric utility by a private equity firm and issue penalties against both, finding they violated state law by completing the sale without approval.
summary_zh: 新墨西哥州监管机构周四投票决定取消一家私募股权公司一年前购买该州最大电力公司股票的行为，并对两家公司进行处罚，发现他们未经批准就完成出售，违反了州法律。
